title: Woman Blames Racism for $4500 Shoplifting Haul at Dick’s Sporting Goods: Cops
description:
Bodycam footage shows two suspected shoplifters getting arrested after allegedly trying to steal over $4500 worth of merchandise from Dick’s Sporting Goods in New York. Cayuga County deputies confronted 21-year-old Rahkeal Jones and her 16-year-old niece after being called about a fight in progress at the same location. Turns out, one of the suspected thieves was involved in the fight. Jones claimed she was being “profiled” and was planning on paying for the goods with her “pocket full of money.” After a bizarre line of questioning, Jones was arrested for larceny and her niece was sent home with a citation. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
